webhooks.detail: No webhook/event subscription found in Pinterest v5 docs. 'Subscribe for updates' page only covers email notices of app/API changes.

evidence.quote: Email Contacts are notified of changes to your application or to the Pinterest API via email.

sandbox.detail: Sandbox at api-sandbox.pinterest.com, usable with Trial or Standard access; needs sandbox token. Trial access is free to request.

evidence.quote: Use Sandbox to test your integration with Pinterest API v5 without affecting your production data.

rate_limits.summary: Trial 1000 req/day; Standard 100 req/s per user per app; per-category limits

evidence.quote: Standard access: 100 requests per second per user per app for all API requests
